verdict.rationale: LibreChat is self-hosted (Docker, npm, or Helm) rather than a SaaS with fixed data centers, so a deploying org can technically choose the hosting region/infrastructure themselves, giving implicit control over data residency. However, there is no explicit documentation, compliance certification, or feature addressing data residency/region selection as a product capability. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency/compliance documentation, region-selection UI/config, and any statement about where managed/cloud data would reside.
